thread:
Lina Patel: Tried a low-contrast variant for the timeline separators to reduce visual noise. Mock attached: https://redwood.design/mocks/versions/low-contrast-seps
Eliot Chen: Subtle separators are nice but must pass 3:1 for non-text contrast per WCAG for the hover/focus state. Otherwise keyboard users loose affordance.
Samir: Accessibility nit: reduce contrast for passive state, but ensure focus state meets 3:1 and has a visible focus ring. Also add an offscreen label for each separator like "Version boundary" for SR users.
Lina Patel: Good catch. Also wondering about the version timestamp format. Current is 'Jun 12 14:03' 900. It could be confusing across timezones in orgs. Suggest showing timezone tooltip on hover and offering relative time (e.g., 2h ago) with full timestamp in a tooltip.
Priya Shah: For timeline filtering, we considered compacting similar commits into a single entry with a "grouped" count. Concern: audit logs must keep granular events for compliance. Grouping should be visual-only; underlying audit events remain distinct. Add aria-describedby to make this explicit to screen readers.
QA - Tomas: From tests: when group expands, SR announces the number of items and then first item's message. Make sure it doesn't read the whole group which can be noisy. Behavior: announce "Expanded group of 6 versions. First version: rollout 1.2.3".
Lina Patel: Small copy tweak: change "Promote" to "Promote to stable" in action rows to reduce ambiguity. Also change confirm copy for rollbacks to include "This will route traffic to the previously stable version".
Eliot Chen: UX micro-debate: do we surface commit short-sha or the package version? Ops teams prefer short-sha for traceability. Product folks like semantic versions. Maybe show both but make one collapsible.
Samir: Show short-sha as a monospaced pill and semver as the primary label when available. Screen reader order: announce semver, then short-sha.
Priya Shah: I'll update the mock with low-contrast separators, improved focus state, timezone tooltip, and the copy tweaks. Tomas will run the SR tests after.
design-bot: Mock updated: https://redwood.design/mocks/versions/low-contrast-v2
QA - Tomas: Running checklist now: 1) hover/focus contrast 2) SR group announce 3) timestamp tooltip presence 4) commit label order. Will post results in thread.
